Local Hardwood, Split and Seasoned for Solon

Roubic Tree & Landscape has been a family-owned NE Ohio operation since 1982, working out of one yard in Auburn Township. Solon is one of our five Tier 1 cities — a short drive from the yard, which keeps delivery simple and keeps the firewood truly local.

Our firewood comes from the trees we take down and prune across the region: oak, maple, ash, and cherry. Instead of chipping every log, the sound hardwood is bucked, split, and stacked to season in our yard. By the time it reaches a Solon driveway, it has been dried toward the low moisture that actually burns clean.

Solon Firewood Know-How

Why Seasoned, Local Firewood Matters in Solon

Firewood burns clean when its moisture content is dry — generally under about 20 percent. Green or under-seasoned wood is hard to light, smokes heavily, and builds creosote in a chimney. Roubic seasons hardwood in the yard so it is ready to burn on delivery rather than needing a full season in your rack first.

Buying local also matters: Ohio guidance discourages moving firewood long distances because it can spread tree pests such as the emerald ash borer. Roubic firewood is cut from NE Ohio trees, so it stays close to where it grew.

What Happens If You Wait

The Cost of Ordering Late — Solon Context

Three reasons Solon homeowners order firewood before they actually need it.

Peak-Season Backlog

When the first hard freeze hits NE Ohio, firewood demand spikes across Solon at once. Ordering ahead of the rush keeps your delivery window short instead of waiting in a queue.

Green Wood Won't Burn Clean

Buy firewood the week you need it and you may get wood that hasn't seasoned. Ordering seasoned hardwood early means it is dry and ready, not smoking and building creosote.

Limited Yard Stock

Firewood is a byproduct of real tree work, so seasoned stock is finite. Specialty species and extra-dry wood can sell out mid-winter; early orders lock in what you want.

Common Solon Firewood Questions

Solon Firewood Delivery FAQ

Six things Solon homeowners want to know before ordering firewood.

What kind of firewood does Roubic deliver in Solon?
Roubic delivers seasoned split hardwood — primarily oak, maple, ash, and cherry cut from the trees we remove and prune across NE Ohio. Because it is local wood we season in our own Auburn Township yard, it arrives dried toward the low moisture that burns clean rather than green off the truck.
How much does firewood cost in Solon?
Firewood is priced per cord based on volume, species mix, and delivery distance. Because rates shift with season and yard stock, we quote the current per-cord price when you call or order and confirm it before delivery — no surprise charges on the driveway. Call {{global.phone}} for today's rate.
How fast can you deliver firewood to Solon?
Solon is one of Roubic's five Tier 1 cities and sits close to our Auburn Township yard, so orders are typically delivered within one to two days of confirming stock. During peak heating season, ordering ahead keeps your delivery window short.
Is the firewood seasoned and ready to burn?
Yes — Roubic seasons hardwood in the yard so it is dry on delivery, generally toward the under-20-percent moisture range that burns clean and builds less creosote. Well-seasoned wood lights easier, smokes less, and puts out more heat than green or under-dried firewood.
Do you stack the firewood or just dump it?
Standard delivery is dumped in your driveway or wherever access allows in Solon. Stacking is available on request — just let us know when you order so the crew can plan for it. Tell us where you want the wood placed and we will get it as close as the site allows.
Why does buying local firewood matter?
Ohio guidance discourages moving firewood long distances because it can spread tree pests such as the emerald ash borer. Roubic firewood is cut from NE Ohio trees and stays close to where it grew, so ordering from a local family operation keeps your wood — and the region's trees — healthier.
